confidence_notes: Current [Numbeo prices](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Lisbon) are proxies for July 2026. Beer is a local 20 cl serving; cocktail and wine estimates use their approximate price relationship to beer from [Lisbon nightlife benchmarks](https://expat-u.com/nightlife-in-lisbon/). Accommodation estimates are model-based and vary with season and booking conditions.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food estimates use Lisbon-specific benchmarks. Accommodation estimates draw on southern European tourist-city experience, adjusted for Lisbon's July demand.
